description: Classify one visitor from its requests to your MCP server, A2A agent or website. Returns the declared identity, the observed behaviour class (acts-on-results, agent-tool-use, agent-message, probe, indexer, web-scanner, web), the signals and reasons, and mismatch=true when behaviour contradicts the declared identity. All event fields are optional; send what your server parsed. At most 500 events.

argsEmpty.description: tools/call with {} or missing required arguments

canaryHit.description: Visit to a link that only appeared inside a tool or agent result

hasText.description: A2A message with text, or MCP call with a free-text intent

rpcError.description: JSON-RPC error code returned, if any

rpcMethod.description: JSON-RPC method (MCP or A2A), e.g. initialize, tools/list, tools/call, message/send

tool.description: Tool name of an MCP tools/call

toolKnown.description: false if the tool does not exist on the server

name: classify_visitor
title: Classify a visitor
